On the export-gap question, this tool can't settle it. The GCP cost query returns one figure per service for the whole window, with no per-day series and no dates, so I can't tell which day was the most expensive. It also can't show how many September days have data. The only other number in the response is daily_rows = 2,316. Despite the name, that is the row count the BigQuery query returned (a diagnostic), not a count of days, so 2,316 rows can't be turned into "N days covered". I cannot confirm whether every September day is present. To check for skipped days, query the billing export table directly, grouped by usage date.
